title: Documents folder
whyItMatters: Contracts, tax papers, medical letters, scans and saved downloads live here. File names and dates alone can expose a lot about the person's life.
source: Windows known folder Documents, default path under the user profile: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/onedrive/redirect-known-folders
notes: If OneDrive Known Folder Move is on, the real Documents folder is under %USERPROFILE% OneDrive and this one may be empty or a stub. Some applications also save wallets and exports here, so count it even when it looks empty.

cleanup.exportFirst: Copy what you want to keep to an external drive or your cloud account before deleting anything in this folder.
steps: Open the folder named in the plan and look through it before deleting anything.
Check for the same files in OneDrive if the folder looks empty, because Known Folder Move can redirect it.
Copy what you keep to a drive you are taking with you, then delete the rest.
cleanup.risk: Anything deleted from this folder is gone unless you copied it out first. Contracts, scans and exports cannot be recreated.
cleanup.source: Microsoft Support, Free up drive space in Windows: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/experience/storage-filemanagement/free-up-drive-space-in-windows
